title: Khoon Bhari Mang
description: Widowed Aarti is trapped in Sanjay's devious marriage plot. With Nandini's help, he tries to drown her and steal her wealth, but she survives and rises to seek revenge.

title: Vanvaas
description: An elderly father abandoned by his sons and struggling with fading memory begins a heartfelt journey, guided by a clever wanderer determined to reunite him with his family.

title: Kasme Vaade
description: Raju, guilt-ridden over his brother's death, meets Amit's lookalike, Shankar, and unknowingly becomes entangled in a deeper mystery, making amends while facing unsettling truths.

title: Saturday Blockbuster- Phool Aur Kante
description: Ajay, the son of a crime boss, lives peacefully until rivals kidnap his father. Forced into the underworld, he must confront danger and fight to save his family.

title: De De Pyaar De 2
description: Ashish Mehra, a London-based NRI investor, visits his girlfriend's family, but tensions escalate when her father discovers the truth about Ashish's real age.

title: B.A.Pass 2
description: A young woman escapes an arranged marriage and moves to Mumbai. Alone in the big city, she faces the tough world of showbiz and discovers the real meaning of life and love.

title: Rashmi Rocket
description: A small-town girl rises to become a national athlete, breaking barriers. Her glory is shattered when she's forced into a humiliating gender test, challenging her dreams.

title: Pure Bollywood
description: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Mere Pyaare Prime Minister
description: Kannu, an eight-year-old boy, writes to India's prime minister after his mother is raped. With two friends, he journeys from Mumbai to Delhi, bravely seeking justice.

title: Kaho Naa Pyar Hai
description: After Rohit's mysterious death, Sonia relocates to New Zealand to heal. There, she meets Raj-Rohit's lookalike-who helps her uncover the truth behind Rohit's murder.

title: Air India Around the World- Dil Chahta Hai
description: Three inseparable friends drift apart after college-Akash moves to Australia, Sameer chases love, and Siddharth immerses in art-each following a different path.

title: No Entry
description: Kishan, a loyal husband, disapproves of his friend Prem's infidelity. But when introduced to Bobby, a prostitute, Kishan's morals are tested, leading to complications, secrets, and unexpected choices.

title: Mega Double Premiere- Bhoot Bangla
description: Arjun inherits his family's haunted estate in rural Mangalpur and hosts his sister Meera's wedding there, accidentally unleashing supernatural forces linked to their dark ancestral legacy.

title: Bhoot Bangla
description: (Extended version) Arjun inherits his family's haunted estate in rural Mangalpur and hosts his sister Meera's wedding there, accidentally unleashing supernatural forces linked to their dark ancestral.

title: Zeher
description: Siddharth, a police officer facing divorce, begins an affair with Anna. When she's found dead, he realises he's entangled in a dangerous mystery beyond his control.
